svg.title: The serving architecture
svg.desc: Hosts as hairline frames, each unit a box on its Unix socket: on cyan, the control host, the callers, LiveKit and the voice worker run in the voice plane's network namespace, which has no route out; the worker reaches the gateway through gateway.sock, and the coding agents reach it through 127.0.0.1:18080 with a tenant's key, the one TCP listener; a tunnel per GPU node carries the gateway's engine requests and the worker's speech over SSH, a key per socket, to the node's three servers: vLLM 0.32 with make-room on engine.sock, Whisper on stt.sock and Kokoro on tts.sock, on Phastform each in a network namespace of its own; Gray, drawn dashed, is a second card when present, its servers in the host's namespace.
svg.text: each server in its own namespace
